name: RSI(4) deep below the 200-day average (rule book, beaten-down stocks)
note: Same rule book as RSI(4) classic (S&P 100 or Nasdaq 100, $5-$250, RSI(4) closes below 15 -> buy next open, max 3 new trades a day, 10 positions, prioritised by past ROI, stop = entry - 4 x ADR(20)), but instead of "above the 200-day average" the stock must be at least 15% BELOW it: buying washed-out stocks. Exit is the same placeholder (RSI(4) back above 55).
